narrative.intro: The ranking shows the fastest-growing federal contract markets for FY2026 to date. Total federal contract obligations for the period are $172B. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the fastest-growing market, up 197.3% year over year. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction is second, up 140.9% year over year. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services is third, up 112.3% year over year. Automobile Manufacturing is fourth, up 97.6% year over year. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) is fifth, up 73.2% year over year. Telecommunications Resellers is sixth, up 62.6% year over year. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is seventh, up 52.3% year over year. Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction is eighth, up 45.6% year over year. Software Publishers is ninth, up 41.6% year over year. Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) is tenth, up 40.8% year over year. The ranking covers fiscal year to date obligations only, so totals are partial for the current fiscal year.

sections.heading: What markets topped the FY2026 to date growth list?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the top market, with growth of 197.3% year over year. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction is the second-fastest, with growth of 140.9% year over year. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services is third, with growth of 112.3% year over year.

sections.heading: How concentrated is the growth among industries?
sections.body: The top ten list mixes construction, manufacturing, professional services, and technology sectors. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing and Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) appear alongside Software Publishers and Telecommunications Resellers, showing growth across different industry types. The list reflects changes in contract obligations for the fiscal year to date and not annualized totals.

faq.q: What are the fastest-growing federal contract markets?
faq.a: The fastest-growing federal contract markets are Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction, and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction grew 197.3% year over year, Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 140.9% year over year, and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services grew 112.3% year over year. The ranking lists the top ten markets by year-over-year change in obligations for the fiscal year to date.

faq.q: How is market growth measured here?
faq.a: Growth is measured by year-over-year change in contract obligations for the same fiscal period. Each market’s percent figure shows the change in obligations compared with the same period in the prior fiscal year, for the fiscal year to date.
